REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, March 20, 2018 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk

a.

d.

2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
a.
Call Meeting to Order
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-m, be approved.

ORD NO. 796 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, Amending 11-1.15.01(A), 11-1.15.10(J), 11-1.15.12(L), 11-1.15.19(S),11-1.30.01, 11-1.30.02, 11-1.30.05, AND 11-1.30.06 to confirm to recently enacted legislation pertaining to Accessory Dwelling Units. (Second Reading)
ACTION: That said ordinance be adopted.
Item #7j
k.
Authorize the City Manager to execute a Lease Agreement with the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Los Angeles for 200 acre-feet of unused FY 2017-18 groundwater pumping rights
ACTION: Staff recommends that City Council authorize the City Manager to execute a Lease Agreement with the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Los Angeles for 200 acre-feet of unused FY 2017-18 groundwater pumping rights, at a price of $100 per acre-foot, for a total of $20,000.
Item #7k
l.
Approval of Final Map for Parcel Map No. 74637 - 2374 247th Street
ACTION: It is recommended that City Council approve the Final Map for Parcel Map No. 74637, as recommended by the City's engineering consultant Quantum Consulting, Inc.
Item #7l
m.
Accept Sanitary Sewer Related Public Improvements for Tract Map No. 73720 (25024 Narbonne Avenue and 2154 250th Street)
ACTION: Staff recommends that the City Council accept the sanitary sewer related public improvements constructed by the developer for Tract Map No. 73720 (25024 Narbonne Avenue and 2154 250th Street); and approve exoneration of all related bonds and securities related to the construction of said sanitary sewer related public improvements.
Item #7m
PUBLIC HEARING:
8.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF ALLOWING DOGS IN THE PARKS
Presented by Parks and Recreation Director Harding
ORD NO. 797 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, amending Section 2-11.04 of the Lomita Municipal Code to allow dogs in City parks and on City property provided dogs are leashed at all times. (First Reading)
ACTION: That after conducting the public hearing, the City Attorney reads the title, to introduce first reading of an ordinance amending Section 2-11.04 of the Lomita Municipal Code to allow dogs in City parks and on City property provided dogs are leashed at all times; and that said ordinance be scheduled for a second reading on April 3, 2018.
Item #8
9.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned the regular meeting to be held on Tuesday, April 3, at 6:30 p.m., in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
